# Week Plan — Monday to Friday

Built from `INBOX.md`. Everything below sits inside 09:30–17:30, Mon–Fri,
respects the Wednesday 13:00–17:30 blackout, keeps at least 45 minutes for
lunch, and keeps meeting load under four hours a day.

## Ground rules and assumptions

| Rule | Source | How it is honoured |
|---|---|---|
| Working hours 09:30–17:30 | inbox | No block starts before 09:30 or ends after 17:30 |
| Wednesday 13:00–17:30 unavailable | inbox | Wednesday is planned as a half day only |
| Lunch ≥ 45 min | inbox | A 45-minute lunch is blocked every day |
| ≤ 4h meetings/day | inbox | Heaviest day is 1h30m (Tue, Wed, Thu) |
| "Half day" of QA | inbox | **Assumed ≈ 4 hours (09:30–13:30). To confirm with Engineering.** |

Assumptions deliberately **not** made: no work outside stated hours, no
weekend work, no cancellations of the recurring meetings, no assumption that
"preferred" or "early this week" are deadlines.

## Priority order

1. **Board numbers** — hard deadline Thursday 12:00, external/board-facing.
2. **Security patch** — hard deadline Friday 16:00, longest dependency chain.
3. **Customer demo** — external commitment, single rehearsal slot available.

Everything else is scheduled around these three. The renewals escalation is a
same-day must-do on Monday but is short and self-contained, so it is placed
first and does not compete for sequencing.

## Dependency chains

```
Board numbers   Lina corrections (Tue ≤11:00)
                  └─> my 2h uninterrupted build (Tue 11:15–13:15)
                        └─> finalise + submit (Thu 10:00–11:30) === 12:00 HARD

Security patch  my review 60–90m (Mon 11:15–12:45)
                  └─> QA half day (Tue 09:30–13:30; QA dark Thu)
                        └─> change window 30m (Tue 14:30–15:00)
                              └─> verify/monitor (Tue 15:00–16:00) === 16:00 Fri HARD
                              fallback: Fri 14:00–14:30

Customer demo   env + Sam rehearsal 90m (Wed 10:00–11:30 — Sam's only slot)
                  └─> optional refresher (Thu 14:00–15:15)
                        └─> demo (Thu 16:00–17:00) === customer HARD

Strategy        3h focus (Mon 13:30–16:15 + Tue 10:15–11:00)
                  └─> send by Tue 11:15 (leadership cutoff 14:00)
                        └─> leadership review (Tue 16:00) -> revisions Wed 11:30
```

## Wednesday — meetings 1h30 (unavailable from 13:00)

## Thursday — meetings 1h30

| Thursday 15:15–16:00 | 0h45 | Demo prep overrun |
| Friday 12:45–15:30 | 2h45 | Anything that slipped; fallback deploy |
| Friday 15:30–17:30 | 2h00 | Last-resort catch-up |

If something new lands mid-week, it consumes this list top-down. The first
things I would give up, in order: Friday deep work, Thursday's demo refresher,
Wednesday's strategy revisions.

|---|---|
| Lina says at Mon 15:00 that the export is late | Keep Tue 11:15–13:15 and build everything that does **not** depend on the corrections. Ask for a firm new ETA and a partial set. Fold corrections in Wed 11:30–12:30, finalise Thu 10:00–11:15. |
| Corrections slip past Wednesday 09:30 | Thursday morning alone cannot produce 2h of work plus buffer before 12:00. Escalate to Finance the same morning: either an extension, or submission built on uncorrected data with deltas flagged. |
| Patch is not review-ready Monday | Review moves to Tue 09:30–11:00; QA to Wed 09:30–13:30; change window to Thu 11:30–12:00 or the Friday fallback. Thursday-morning board work takes priority. |
| QA fails or QA needs longer than half a day | QA cannot run Thursday. Re-test Friday 09:30–13:30, change window Friday 14:00–14:30. This is the last safe path before 16:00. |
| Rehearsal shows the demo environment is broken | Fix Thursday 14:00–15:15. If it cannot be fixed in time, ask Product to offer the customer a Friday slot rather than demo something broken. |
| Customer cannot do Thursday 16:00 | No other confirmed slot exists; Product to collect fresh options. Wednesday 15:00 is not available to me. |
| Escalations B or C grow beyond 45m each | They are already pulled ahead of their Wednesday SLA; overflow goes to Thursday 12:30–14:00, not to the board or patch blocks. |
